idea-plugin.name: Zigote
idea-plugin.description:
Rider support for the Zigote UI framework.
  • Colour swatches in the gutter for new Color(0xFF2196F3), Color.FromHex, Color.Rgb and Color.Rgba, with the platform colour picker on click.
  • Preview Zigote Widget (Alt+Shift+P) — runs the widget at the caret on its own under dotnet watch, so saving reloads it.
  • A Zigote tool window: the running app's frame — live and interactive (click, drag, scroll and type on the picture), streamed at animation rate — plus its widget tree and accessibility tree, with pickers for project, widget, device size, theme and locale, none of which restart the app.
Both halves live in the framework (Zigote.UI.Host.WidgetPreview and InspectServer) and are driven by environment variables and a loopback socket, so they work without this plugin too.

action.description: Run the widget at the caret on its own, reloading on save
